nc.description: A light grey, faceted vertical post with an attached arm and side panel is shown with its rectangular top piece detached and hovering slightly above it.
A 3D model depicts a conveyor belt carrying rectangular blocks into a funnel-like mechanism that connects to a machine with a control panel.
An abstract 3D rendering shows a mechanical object composed of two large rounded shapes connected by a segmented arm and central interlocking gears.
A low-poly grey 3D model composed of a central block, a large disc, a faceted handle, and a small lever is rendered against a white background.
A central, angular white object is surrounded by a symmetrical arrangement of white rectangular blocks and slotted bars with pivoting arms on a white background.

vc.description: A grey mechanical clamp with a ribbed outer band and a side lever is shown with its top section partially open against a white background.
A grey 3D model depicts a mechanical assembly where articulated arms with circular pads are positioned on rectangular containers along a track connected to gears and shafts.
A light grey mechanical assembly featuring gears, interconnected linkages, and tubular handles with knurled grips rests on a white surface.
A light gray mechanical device featuring a claw, a ribbed cylindrical section, a grooved component, and a cracked lever is displayed against a white background.
A grey hand tool is surrounded by a radial arrangement of mechanical arms, small round pellets, and grooved rectangular pads on a white surface.
